Study: Native obstacle appearance study; no installation, collision or gameplay change

Assumptions.Selection: First row-major feature cell; replace its entire cardinal component. Rubble keeps one model; heavy debris uses the existing connected 3x3 partition
Assumptions.Footprint: Source nominal XY 1x1. Rubble keeps uniform XY scale from component cell count; heavy debris follows the patch long axis. Irregular occupied cells remain the gameplay footprint
Assumptions.GroundScale: Rubble X=Y=1.6*(0.42+0.19*sqrt(component cell count)). HeavyDebris scales source X along the long patch axis, source Y along the short axis, fits the rotated +/-0.46 source envelope using PlanarFit, then applies the stable rotation. The game then stretches grid Y by sqrt(2)
Assumptions.Variety: Stable spatial anchor chooses the body variant and turn; heavy debris retains the existing furniture/console/rack/canopy families. VariantOverride only stages an explicit visual comparison
Assumptions.Height: Rubble: source Z multiplied by min(2, uniform XY scale). HeavyDebris: source Z unchanged
